message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.** The City of Atlanta enforces a local noise ordinance through its **Code Enforcement** office and the **Atlanta Police Department**. While the city council itself doesn’t handle individual complaints, the council’s ordinances give the city the authority to enforce noise regulations. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal:
• Select “Noise” or “Code Enforcement” and fill out the form. | Online portal | | **Phone** | • Call 311 (within Atlanta) or 404‑656‑3111 (outside the city).
• Provide details: location, time, type of noise, and any evidence (photos, videos). | 311 / 404‑656‑3111 | | **Email** | • Send an email to **noise@atlantaga.gov** with the same details. | noise@atlantaga.gov | | **In‑person** | • Visit City Hall (1400 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303) during business hours.
• Speak with a Code Enforcement officer. | City Hall, 1400 Peachtree St. NW | ### What Information Is Needed 1. **Exact address or intersection** of the noise source. 2. **Time and date** of the disturbance. 3. **Description of the noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 4. **Duration** (how long it persisted). 5. **Any evidence** (photos, videos, audio recordings). 6. **Your contact information** (so the city can follow up). --- ## Relevant Law Category - **Noise Ordinance** – falls under **Public Safety / Code Enforcement**. - The ordinance sets permissible decibel limits, quiet hours, and penalties for violations. - Violations can result in citations, fines, or other enforcement actions. --- ## Quick Reference - **City of Atlanta 311**: 404‑656‑3111 (or dial 311 within the city). - **City Hall**: 1400 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303. - **Online Portal**: - **Email**: noise@atlantaga.gov Feel free to use any of these methods to report the noise. The city’s Code Enforcement team will investigate and take appropriate action.
